items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: But I didn't play too much with him.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. But I didn't play too much with him. I don't want to say something that's wrong. I didn't play too much. Oh, I know, I heard him play. He lived right next door to the union. That's where he was, and he'd practice out there, you'd hear him practicing in the daytime. You know, Buddy, it's the funniest thing, I can't -- those guys -- they come to my mind, but they go away. I don't know
I think talking about it is good, because you remember a lot of --
